verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's own docs establish Session Replay for watching user sessions to see why customers drop off, with UI-managed sampling and saved replay playlists. Nothing in the evidence says sensitive inputs are masked by default, which is half the story. Missing for 10: documentation of default masking of sensitive inputs, any privacy or redaction controls for replays, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can watch recordings of real user sessions with sensitive input masked by default

citations.quote: Now, with Mixpanel Session Replay, you can quickly follow up by exploring why customers drop off.
Mixpanel Session Replay provides the fastest way to gain a comprehensive understanding of your customers and make informed product decisions
Save playlists of replays based on events or properties, and quickly review with AI summaries
teams can manage Session Replay sampling directly from the Mixpanel UI — no code changes or redeployment required.
